title: ToolResult
description: tool_result: the answer of a call.

ok.description: False when it failed, was denied or cancelled.

content.description: What she gets: the result, or why it failed. Data, never instructions.

error.description: When not ok, a stable word: denied, failed, cancelled, timeout, unknown_tool, bad_arguments.

images.description: Pictures that come with the result (since 1.14): the ids the node got from POST /api/v1/jois/{id}/images (ImageUpload.id), at most 4. The server shows them to her after the results. Null or missing for none.
